title: Warehouse tablet is slow, and the slowness runbook excludes it

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
The stock tablet takes about thirty seconds to open anything and the scanning
app keeps closing itself. It has been getting worse for a fortnight.

We can share the one in the office for now but it slows the whole bay down.

Dan

handling.escalation_reason: The slowness runbook covers company-managed laptops and says it does not apply to the warehouse tablets.

rationale: The 'Laptop running slowly' runbook is going to score well here - the words are almost identical - and its Scope section rules the warehouse tablets out. Following it anyway would send an Android tablet user to Task Manager and the recycle bin. There is a workaround, sharing the office tablet, so P3 (G1). The pair with case-057 is the point: two different runbooks, both excluding the warehouse by name, both the top hit for the ticket that excludes them (G10).
